title: Deep Learning for Forecasting Stock Returns in the Cross-Section

data_binding.reason: shared benchmark data replaces the paper's native dataset and protocol

requirements: Monthly MSCI Japan Index constituent universe.
Monthly dividend-inclusive stock returns at end of month.
Twenty-five monthly factors calculated from market and financial data.
Financial data from WorldScope and Reuters Fundamentals with WorldScope priority and a four-month reporting lag.
Forecast data from Thomson Reuters Estimates and I/B/E/S Estimates with Thomson Reuters priority.
MSCI Barra JPE4 Historical Beta and Predicted Specific Risk for factors 18 and 24.

dimensions.implication: The benchmark uses a frozen shared dataset rather than the paper's original data.
A changed information interval alters the empirical claim.
Only an explicitly named MethodCard model branch may enter the benchmark.
